prompt.es: Modera la mesa: presenta, da dos turnos, resume y cierra.

answer.text: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to tonight's panel. Our topic is technology in the classroom. Let me introduce our three panellists: Ana, who uses tablets every day; Tom, who teaches science; and Sara, who has three children at school. Ana, would you like to start? Thank you, Ana. Tom, it is your turn. Sorry to cut in, Tom, but coming back to the topic, could you tell us about the cost? Thank you. Before we move on, let me recap. Ana stressed that tablets saved time and made lessons more fun. Tom doubted that schools could afford them, and he warned that screens could distract students. Sara suggested that we write clear rules, and she conceded that tablets had real benefits. Sara, what would your first rule be? Seldom have I seen three guests agree on so much. To wrap up, all of you agree that rules matter more than machines. I am grateful to each panellist for a lively discussion, and I thank our audience for listening. Good night, everyone.

origin.text: Mesa redonda de tres voces sobre tecnología en el aula (Ana a favor, Tom con dudas sobre el coste, Sara pide normas). Escribe en inglés lo que dirías como moderadora (unas 130–220 palabras): da la bienvenida y presenta el tema y a los ponentes; cede dos turnos; reconduce con cortesía; resume cada postura con verbos variados (stressed, doubted, suggested…); y cierra agradeciendo.
